globalSettings.sceneBoundaryRule: scene-n final frame and scene-(n+1) opening frame should begin from the same pose, camera baseline, geography, prop state, and harness state before motion continues
globalSettings.style: warm observational pet webtoon motion, original 001 drawing style preserved, clean linework, soft painterly shading, bright daytime Tancheon riverside, readable geography, comic anecdote tone
globalSettings.negativePromptCommon: text, letters, subtitles, captions, numbers, logos, watermarks, duplicate pet, second version of same dog, extra dog, extra animal, wings, extra limbs, duplicated head, merged face, broken anatomy, wrong pet identity, wrong fur color, wrong harness color, wrong ear shape, style drift, photorealistic repaint, glossy anime repaint, horror tone, drowning panic, duck injury, violent duck capture, bite attack, gore, blurry
globalSettings.compositionRule: Keep Jjiroo and Jjonga identical to the approved storyboard and keyframe plan. Preserve the same Tancheon riverside geography from duck sighting to water entry to climb-out bank. Keep generated frames text-free and comic rather than dangerous.

providerExpectations.keyframeGate: Use the approved storyboard bundle as the visual image anchor and keyframe-plan.json as the motion/timing map before generating any scene video.
providerExpectations.pictureStage: Generate mute picture-only clips first, then hand off to POST for narration, SFX, BGM, typography, color, and final assembly.
providerExpectations.continuityRule: Scene-01 starts from the approved storyboard anchor. Scene-02 through scene-10 start from the prior scene handoff frame and aim toward the approved storyboard pose for that scene without resetting geography.
providerExpectations.textRule: Do not bake captions, CTA, labels, letters, numbers, logos, or any readable text into generated frames.
providerExpectations.castCardinalityRule: Each scene must show exactly the listed cast counts. Do not add duplicate pets, extra dogs, extra ducks, or second versions of any character.
providerExpectations.sceneDelivery: Each completed scene should yield one picture clip, one provider manifest, and one extracted last-frame asset for the next handoff.
